instruction.text: Lies die Geschichte von Christopher Columbus.
instruction.sound: Lies die Geschichte von <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>Christopher Columbus.</voice>

atoms.text: This is Christopher Columbus. He was an Italian explorer in the 15th and 16th century.
He wanted to find a route to India. He had planned a voyage for years.

In August 1492, Columbus and his crew set off. In October, they saw land and thought it was their destination which was India. That's why Christopher Columbus called the people living there “Indians”.
atoms.sound: In August 1492, Columbus and his crew set off. In October, they saw land and thought it was their destination which was India. That's why Christopher Columbus called the people living there Indians.

hint.sound: to set off <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>bedeutet aufbrechen.</voice> destination <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>bedeutet Ziel.</voice>

atoms.text: But Columbus was wrong. He and his crew reached several islands in the Caribbean in Central America (for example: Bahamas, Cuba, and Hispaniola). So the people who lived there weren't Indians but indigenous people. Still, he believed that he found a new route to India.
atoms.sound: But Columbus was wrong. He and his crew reached several islands in the Caribbean in Central America - for example the Bahamas, Cuba and Hispaniola. So the people who lived there weren't Indians but indigenous people. Still, he believed that he found a new route to India.

hint.sound: to reach sth. <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>bedeutet etwas erreichen.</voice>

atoms.text: In January 1493, Columbus returned to Europe. He brought plants, gold and several indigenous people with him.
Columbus went on four voyages to the Americas in total. He died in Spain in 1506. Up until his death, he still believed that he discovered a new route to India.
atoms.sound: Columbus went on four voyages to the Americas in total. He died in Spain in 1506. Up until his death, he still believed that he discovered a new route to India.

hint.text: the Americas – Bezeichnung für den amerikanischen Doppelkontinent (Nord- und Südamerika)
hint.sound: the Americas <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>ist die Bezeichnung für den amerikanischen Doppelkontinent: Nord- und Südamerika.</voice>

atoms.text: Just one year later, it became clear that Columbus' “India” wasn't the actual India. The newfound continent got named after Amerigo Vespucci, an Italian explorer, who also set off to explore that continent.
atoms.sound: Just one year later, it became clear that Columbus' India wasn't the actual India. The newfound continent got named after Amerigo Vespucci, an Italian explorer, who also set off to explore that continent.

atoms.text: Up until today, Christopher Columbus is known for his accidental “discovery” of the Americas in 1492. But he wasn't the first European to explore the continent. About 500 years earlier, the Norse explorer Leif Erikson already set foot in the Americas.

atoms.text: When the discovery of the new continent spread through Europe, the leaders of the countries in Europe heard about it and wanted to rule over the Americas. One of their motivations was the fertile land which they could use for agriculture. That's why many countries sent some of their people to the Americas. They wanted them to establish colonies there.

atoms.text: When a group of people from a country claim land in another country and settle there, it's called a colony. That's also why the people living in a colony are called settlers. The people claiming the land are called colonisers. The ruler of the country who sent colonisers keeps control over the colony.

atoms.a: What did the leaders of countries in Europe want to do with the Americas?
b: They wanted to leave it to the indigenous people.
They wanted to split it into three parts.

atoms.a: How are the people who claim land called?

instruction.text: Lies den Text und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.title: Relationships between colonisers and indigenous people

atoms.text:
The indigenous tribes treated the colonisers differently:
Some tribes saw the colonisers as enemies, while others welcomed them. Some tribes taught the colonisers how to survive, others used the weapons of the colonisers against their old enemies.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>Im amerikanischen Englisch wird</voice> coloniser <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>mit Z anstatt mit S geschrieben.</voice>

atoms.a: What did some indigenous people do with the colonisers' weapons?
b: They used them to grow vegetables.
They used them to welcome new people.

atoms.text: The positive image of colonisers changed over time because they brought new laws and religion and forced them onto the indigenous people. Some of the colonisers also carried diseases with them that were unknown to the indigenous people. This was problematic because the tribes did not know how to treat them and many people became very ill and died.

atoms.a: What did the colonisers bring to America?

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>Mehrere Antworten können richtig sein.</voice>

atoms.text: Because more and more people came to America, they needed more space to build homes. That's why the colonisers forced the indigenous people to give up their land. One of the most famous ships that brought people from Great Britain to America is called “Mayflower”. Over 100 passengers were on it. They arrived in Cape Cod, Massachusetts, in 1620.
